statements.text: AKT1 to MTOR, shortest directed route in KEGG hsa04151 (PI3K-Akt signaling pathway): AKT1/AKT3/AKT2 -[inhibition +p]-> TSC2:TSC1 -[inhibition]-> RHEB -[activation]-> RPTOR:MTOR:MLST8. Each step is a KEGG-drawn relation; a route is a curated summary and may skip intermediates.

PIK3CA to AKT1, shortest directed route in KEGG hsa04151 (PI3K-Akt signaling pathway): PIK3CA/P3R3URF-PIK3R3/PIK3CB (+4) -[activation]-> Phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate -[activation]-> AKT1/AKT3/AKT2. Each step is a KEGG-drawn relation; a route is a curated summary and may skip intermediates.

PIK3CA to MTOR, shortest directed route in KEGG hsa04151 (PI3K-Akt signaling pathway): PIK3CA/P3R3URF-PIK3R3/PIK3CB (+4) -[activation]-> Phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate -[activation]-> AKT1/AKT3/AKT2 -[inhibition +p]-> TSC2:TSC1 -[inhibition]-> RHEB -[activation]-> RPTOR:MTOR:MLST8. Each step is a KEGG-drawn relation; a route is a curated summary and may skip intermediates.

notes: No directed KEGG route for: AKT1 -> PIK3CA; MTOR -> AKT1; MTOR -> PIK3CA. This reflects the map's drawing, not proof that no regulation exists.
KEGG hsa04151 contains 85 reconstructable relations; 5 are kept for this question.
diagram_note: Directed relations redrawn from the KEGG map (KGML). Arrow = activation, x = inhibition, dashed = expression/indirect. Multi-gene boxes are paralog groups that KEGG draws as one node.
